name: Dialog
summary: Presents modal content with focus management and dismissal.

useWhen: Blocking a task until a decision is made

obligations: Expose dialog semantics and modal behavior by making sibling content inert.
Trap focus while open and restore focus when closed.
Support Escape and backdrop dismissal when enabled.

behavior: Delegate portal mounting, inert outside content, scroll locking, topmost dismissal, and focus restoration to RAC Modal and ModalOverlay.

If the element focused when the Dialog opened has left the DOM when the Dialog closes or unmounts, move focus to the nearest ancestor recorded at opening that is still connected and focusable, after React Aria's own restore frame; with no such ancestor, focus stays on the document body.
Use DialogTrigger when a trigger is supplied and let ModalOverlay own controlled or uncontrolled state otherwise.
Render optional description and actions with stable muxui-dialog-description and muxui-dialog-actions selectors.
Keep Mux UI part classes when applying consumer backdrop, panel, title, description, content, actions, and close classes; preserve default styling unless the consumer overrides it.

With dismissable false, reject accidental dismissal by Escape, outside press, or trigger toggle; an explicit slot="close" button in the content or actions still requests close, which closes an uncontrolled Dialog and calls onOpenChange(false) for a controlled owner.
accessibility: Require a title, aria-label, or aria-labelledby and expose role dialog with modal focus containment and outside-content exclusion.
Generate an accessible title relationship when title is provided.
Provide a labelled close button when dismissable.
Associate description through a stable generated ID and merge it with caller aria-describedby references.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
